name: Mor'rogal
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal sends Horde travelers toward the dangers and promise of the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: Watcher in the Crags
sections.body: Deep crevices and caverns cut into the Stonetalon Mountains, and Mor'rogal keeps his eye on them. Their twisting passages may hold riches, but they can also bring deadly danger. So Mor'rogal sends brave Horde wanderers to troubled places such as Boulderslide Ravine. Facing those depths tests the spirit of anyone who seeks glory with heart and soul.

faq.answer: Mor'rogal is a tauren guide in Sun Rock Retreat, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He urges Horde travelers to test their mettle in the dangerous caves and ravines scattered across the mountains.
You can find Mor'rogal in Sun Rock Retreat, the main Horde outpost among the peaks of the central Stonetalon Mountains.
Mor'rogal sends capable champions to the cave at Boulderslide Ravine, where kobolds mine Resonite crystals. Then he asks them to slay Goggeroc, a sleeping Earthen the kobolds dug up.

faq.q: Why is Mor'rogal focused on caves and ravines?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal believes Stonetalon's perilous caverns offer adventure and a test of spiritual resolve. Those willing to risk their lives may find glory and riches.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may see Kalimdor's deep stone hollows as sacred ground, where physical and spiritual trials can prove your worth.
As a member of the Horde arriving at Sun Rock Retreat, you can turn to Mor'rogal for information about threats in the crags beyond the settlement.
